title: Graded submodules of finite graded modules are finitely generated
statement: Let k be a field and S=k[x_0,x_1] with the total-degree grading, in the convention [def-sc-p1-standard]. If N is a finitely generated graded S-module and K is a graded S-submodule of N, then K is a finitely generated graded S-module.
